messages:
sara: Heads-up: AcmeRetail reported an API error + a repro that contains customer PII. They saw a 500 on generation and also streaming aborted mid-response. Request IDs: req_01F8X1ABCD23, req_01F8X1ABCD24. Also customer mentions billing shows "0 balance" incorrectly for a short window. Need triage: collect sanitized debug bundle, curl repro, server logs filtered by req IDs, and confirm billing headers. Can we coordinate redaction steps before attaching bundle?

mike: Copy. Can you paste the curl repro (with token redacted) and the exact request-id headers you saw? Also note whether this was Dedicated or Hosted API.

sara: Repro (hosted):
```
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Request-ID: req_01F8X1ABCD23" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4r-redwood","prompt":"Hi, please summarize this purchase: Customer email: alice+order99@example.com, phone: +1 (555) 444-3333, credit_card: 4242-4242-4242-4242"}'
```
I removed the actual bearer token. The customer said response cut off after ~2s and then we returned 500 in logs.

anna: Please DO NOT upload raw prompt with real emails/phones. Before creating the debug bundle, redact PII. Minimal redaction rules I need here: replace emails with <EMAIL>, phones with <PHONE>, mask full credit card to last4 like ****-****-****-4242, and obfuscate SSN-like patterns to <SSN>. If folks want a quick local sanitize:

Sed example (bash):
```
sed -E -e 's/[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}/<EMAIL>/g' \
    -e 's/\+?[0-9][0-9 ()-]{6,}/<PHONE>/g' \
    -e 's/[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{4}/****-****-****-\4/g' prompt.json > prompt.sanitized.json
```
Or tiny python if you need stronger rules:
```
import re, json
p = json.load(open('prompt.json'))
s = p['prompt']
s = re.sub(r"[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}", "<EMAIL>", s)
s = re.sub(r"\+?[0-9][0-9 ()-]{6,}", "<PHONE>", s)
s = re.sub(r"(\d{4}-\d{4}-\d{4}-(\d{4}))", lambda m: '****-****-****-' + m.group(2)[-4:], s)
p['prompt'] = s
json.dump(p, open('prompt.sanitized.json','w'))
```
I can review sanitized prompt before upload.

omar: For the server side, grep logs by request id to pull full trace:
```
# on prod-logs host
rg "req_01F8X1ABCD23|req_01F8X1ABCD24" /var/log/redwood/*.log | sed -n '1,200p'
```
From partial logs posted by the customer we see: 
```
2026-03-17T09:12:43Z INFO handler: received request id=req_01F8X1ABCD23 size=1342
2026-03-17T09:12:45Z WARN runtime: kvcache miss model=gpt-4r-redwood
2026-03-17T09:12:45Z ERROR stream: websocket closed code=1006 client_abort
2026-03-17T09:12:45Z ERROR api: generation failed id=req_01F8X1ABCD23 err="unexpected EOF"
```
Also check p95/p99 latency around that time (we had a small spike: p95 ~ 420ms, p99 ~ 1.8s) — doesn't fully explain aborted stream though.

jess: I can open a support debug bundle for this thread. @support-bot can you create a bundle id and upload URL? Include retention and encryption info.

support-bot: Debug bundle created: dbg-20260317-015. Presigned upload URL: https://s3.redwood-internal/example-upload/dbg-20260317-015?sig=REDACTED (expires in 1 hour). Retention: 30 days, encrypted with customer KMS (if provided). Please do NOT include raw customer tokens or full CC numbers in the upload. Mark the bundle as "sanitized" in the metadata.

sara: Uploaded prompt.sanitized.json and filtered logs as dbg-20260317-015/prompt.sanitized.json and dbg-20260317-015/logs-filtered.txt to the presigned URL at 09:24Z. Confirmed I replaced alice+order99@example.com -> <EMAIL> and phone -> <PHONE>. Bundle notes: hosted request, region=us-west-2, customer_org=acme-retail, sample request-ids included.

mike: Thanks. One note on billing: customer reported a short window with balance 0; that often correlates with missing metering header x-tenant-billing or a late ingestion lag. @kevin can you check billing events for acme-retail around 2026-03-17T09:10-09:30Z? Provide an escalation if a ledger gap is found.

kevin: Will do. Run this internal query against metering: SELECT * FROM billing.events WHERE org='acme-retail' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-17T09:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-17T09:40:00Z' ORDER BY ts DESC; If anyone can DM me the customer_org id or paste the org id in thread I will run it now.

anna: I will spot-check the sanitized prompt in the bundle. If anything still looks risky I will redact and replace in-place and re-upload. Also, please keep all raw tokens out of the thread.

sara: Understood. I dropped the token, credit card masked to ****-****-****-4242, no SSN patterns left. I added a short reproduction README in the bundle explaining exact curl and environment. I'll follow up here when billing/infra confirm.

mike: Great. If infra finds a transient runtime bug I'll open a runtime incident and link the dbg id. If billing finds a ledger gap, we'll loop in CS for credit action. Thanks everyone — tagging @anna for final PII signoff and @kevin for billing check."
